notes.title: Over 30K downloads
notes.content:
A message for all players,

We would like to thank you all for downloading and playing our game. Over 30K downloads already in a short period of time!

To celebrate this success, we would like to gift everyone of our audience a little present. We welcome everyone to our new tutorial level where you can practice your skills and get more space to try out your moves with less obstacles!

For all achievers, stay tuned! We will release free achievement skins for all the pro's! A small sneak preview of those skins in our thank you image! These skins become available once you reach a certain place at the leaderboard, more about that soon!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31573413/cb497b84fbe76ee869e84ce57e0c9f70fa0ad987.jpg[/img]

Thanks for playing and stay tuned!

Development

notes.title: Discord Channel
notes.content:
Fellow Discorders,

In order to create a community in which people can challenge others we have created a Discord channel. This Discord is meant for bug-reports, social chats, replays, announcements and speedrunners. Also streamers and youtubers are very welcome to share their videos!

You can join our channel with the link below.

https://discord.gg/8aDSUVs


See you at Discord!

The Dev Team
